note: Prompts for tools/art/gen_ai_art.py. Recurring cast: CASS = woman late 20s, long voluminous wavy auburn-red hair, gold five-pointed star greasepaint over her left eye (from 1988 on), red leather jacket. TOMMY = young man, curly brown hair, blue satin varsity jacket. ARLO = wiry man in his 60s, grey crew cut, grey horseshoe moustache, sun-leathered skin, faded olive film-crew jacket. DUTCH = huge bald man in his 50s, burn scars over the left side of face and scalp, silver aluminised pyrotechnics suit, welding goggles pushed up on his forehead. RUDY = nervous TV floor manager in his 30s, headset, clipboard, beige cardigan, big glasses.

portraits.style: Painted head-and-shoulders character portrait for a 1980s neo-noir video game. Realistic oil painting with visible brushwork, front-facing, looking at the viewer, dark textured purple-magenta studio backdrop with a cyan rim light on one side and warm key light on the face. Square format, face centred, shoulders visible. No text.

arlo.prompt: Arlo Vance: a wiry man in his 60s, grey crew cut, grey horseshoe moustache, sun-leathered deeply lined skin, tired cunning eyes, faded olive film-crew jacket with a small embroidered gold star, a dog whistle on a cord around his neck.

dutch.prompt: Dutch Kowalski, 'The Fireman': a huge bald man in his 50s, shiny burn scars across the left side of his face and scalp, a calm unsettling smile, silver aluminised fireproof pyrotechnics suit, welding goggles pushed up on his forehead, faint orange firelight on his face.

rudy.prompt: Rudy, a nervous TV floor manager in his 30s: big square glasses, sweaty forehead, curly thinning hair, a headset microphone, beige cardigan over a loud patterned shirt, holding a clipboard to his chest, comic anxious expression.

dana.prompt: Officer Dana Pruitt, a police officer in her early 30s, tired intelligent eyes with dark circles, dark hair in a tight bun, 1980s California police uniform, a paper coffee cup.

director.prompt: A mysterious film director seen only in silhouette against a blinding projector beam, wearing a flat cap and aviator sunglasses that catch the light, holding a director's megaphone; the face is completely in shadow.

tommy_burnt.prompt: A horror portrait: Tommy Moreno, a young man with curly brown hair, but half his face is charred and glowing with embers like cooling coals, his blue satin varsity jacket scorched, one eye clear and kind, the other a burning ember; smoke curling up. Tragic, not monstrous.

dead.prompt: An eerie portrait of a ghost: a pale, grey-skinned man in a teal 1980s motel security uniform, faintly translucent, blank milky eyes, a small gold star painted on his forehead, cold blue light, mist around him. Quietly unsettling, not gory.

mom.prompt: Cass Moreno's mother: a kind, tired woman in her late 50s with greying auburn hair in a loose bun, reading glasses on a chain, a cardigan over a floral blouse, holding a beige telephone receiver to her ear, warm kitchen light, soft worried smile.

cass_star.prompt: Cass Moreno, the same woman as the reference: long wavy auburn hair, red leather jacket, no headset. Over her left eye she has painted a big bold five-pointed star in shiny metallic GOLD greasepaint, thick and opaque, the star's points reaching her eyebrow and cheekbone, catching the light - it must read clearly even as a tiny thumbnail. Hard, determined, grieving expression, jaw set.

shots.style: Painted cinematic key frame for a 1980s neo-noir action video game set in California. Realistic oil painting with visible brushwork in the style of painted 1980s movie posters, deep indigo and purple shadows, hot magenta and cyan neon rim lighting, warm amber practical lights, soft film grain. Wide 16:9 cinematic composition: keep the main subject in the central band, nothing important near the top or bottom edges. No text, no captions, no watermark unless described.

desert_road.prompt: Night in the Mojave desert, 1987: a lonely two-lane highway running to the horizon, a film crew's trucks and tall work lights glowing far away, a black 1970s Cadillac parked on the road, Joshua trees, a starry sky with a violet-orange glow on the horizon, dust in the air.

cass_close.prompt: Close-up of Cass Moreno on a desert film set at night in 1987 (no star makeup yet), wearing a crew headset over her hair and a red leather jacket, worried eyes looking off-camera, lit by harsh white work lights with magenta rim light, blurred crew and cameras behind her.

tommy_car.prompt: Tommy Moreno sitting in the driver's seat of a black 1970s Cadillac at night, grinning through the open window, blue satin varsity jacket, a small gold star charm hanging from the rear-view mirror, film lights reflecting on the chrome, desert behind.

clapper.prompt: Extreme close-up of a film clapperboard held up in front of a camera lens at night; the slate is chalk-written: HOTSHOT, SCENE 40, TAKE 1. Behind it, out of focus, a car on a desert road and film lights.

explosion.prompt: A black Cadillac exploding into a huge fireball on a desert highway at night during a film shoot, film cameras on tripods silhouetted in the foreground, burning debris flying, orange light flooding everything.

wreck.prompt: The aftermath: a burned-out Cadillac wreck still burning on a desert road at night, a film crew standing perfectly still in silhouette with cameras still rolling, empty red fire extinguishers dropped on the asphalt, smoke drifting across the stars. Chilling and quiet.

machine.prompt: Close-up of a beige 1980s answering machine on a dark wooden desk, its red message light glowing, a cassette visible in the window, a coiled phone cord, blue neon light slicing through window blinds across it.

package.prompt: An opened brown paper package on a scratched wooden table at night: inside, a small brass tin of gold greasepaint, a motel room key on a diamond-shaped plastic fob reading 204, and a Polaroid photo of a smiling young man with curly brown hair. Warm lamp light, neon glow from the window.

mirror.prompt: Cass Moreno in a small bathroom lit by a ring of bare vanity bulbs, painting a gold five-pointed star over her left eye with her fingertip, seen in the mirror, determined and haunted expression, red leather jacket, steam on the glass edges.

motel_night.prompt: The Sunset Palms Motel in Barstow at night in heavy rain: a two-storey 1960s motel with a glowing pink-and-cyan neon sign reading SUNSET PALMS and a VACANCY sign, palm trees, a wet parking lot reflecting neon, a lone car arriving with headlights on.

motel_crime.prompt: Dawn after a massacre at a desert motel: police cars with red and blue lights, yellow crime-scene tape, covered bodies on stretchers, a TV news van, detectives with coffee, the neon motel sign still flickering in the grey morning.

marv.prompt: Marv Kessel, a slick TV host with black slicked-back hair, burgundy suit jacket, black shirt and gold tie, smiling a showman's smile on a glitzy late-night TV set with a giant glowing gold star behind him, studio lights and glitter in the air.

polaroid.prompt: Close-up of an old Polaroid lying on a dark table: it shows a desert film set with a car and crew, and someone has written the initials A.V. on the white border in black marker. A cigarette burn on one corner, neon reflections.

salvage_yard.prompt: A desert salvage yard at night, empty of people: chain-link fence topped with barbed wire, towers of crushed cars, a crane, harsh sodium floodlights, a sign on the fence reading BEWARE OF DOG, and several pairs of glowing red dog eyes in the darkness between the wrecks.

galaxy_palace.prompt: Inside the Galaxy Palace arcade in 1990: rows of glowing arcade cabinets, star-patterned carpet, neon planets on the ceiling, a lone young woman in a harlequin jacket with her back to us playing a machine, a high-score screen glowing.

barstow_pd.prompt: A small-town police station at night in the rain, 1991: Officer Dana Pruitt, a tired woman in her early 30s with dark hair in a bun, alone at a desk buried in case files and Polaroids pinned with gold stars, a cold coffee, red light from a patrol car outside the window.

hills_fire.prompt: The Hollywood hills burning at night in 1992: a wall of wildfire on the ridge, burning palm trees, ash falling like snow over a freeway, and on a hilltop a lone film camera on a tripod silhouetted against the flames.

yermo_office.prompt: A cramped salvage-yard office at 3 AM: a wall of small CRT security monitors showing a fenced yard, cheap wood panelling, a calendar with dogs, a bottle of whiskey, a rottweiler asleep on a rug, an old HOTSHOT film-crew jacket on a hook, rain on the window.

arlo_close.prompt: Arlo Vance, a wiry man in his 60s with a grey crew cut and horseshoe moustache, sitting behind a cluttered desk lit by the blue glow of security monitors, a shotgun resting across his lap, a glass of whiskey, a bleak knowing smile.

live_monitors.prompt: Close-up of a stack of CRT security monitors in a dark office: every screen shows the same red-haired woman with a gold star on her face walking through a salvage yard, from different angles, and in the corner of each screen a small red LIVE tally light. Unsettling.

red_dot.prompt: Arlo Vance, a wiry man in his 60s with a grey crew cut and grey horseshoe moustache, sitting at his cluttered salvage-yard office desk at night, looking calmly toward the window; a small red laser dot rests on his chest. Behind him the window is streaked with rain and has a single bullet hole spiderwebbing the glass; outside, floodlights and the silhouettes of guard dogs in the yard. Blue monitor glow.

burbank_night.prompt: Burbank at night during the Santa Ana winds, 1988: the KHSC Channel 9 studio lot with a big blocky soundstage marked STAGE 9, palm trees bending hard in the wind, dust and leaves flying, a huge billboard reading HOTSHOT CALIFORNIA - TONIGHT 11PM, and the hills behind glowing orange with wildfire.

stage_door.prompt: A studio stage door lit by a red WHEN LIGHT IS ON DO NOT ENTER lamp: Rudy, a nervous floor manager with big glasses, a headset and beige cardigan, holding a clipboard, waving someone in with frantic comic urgency, wind blowing papers off his clipboard.

room_204_set.prompt: Inside a dark TV soundstage: a perfect replica of a cheap motel room, number 204, built as a film set with only three walls, surrounded by studio cameras, boom microphones and lights all pointed at the empty bed, a gold star painted on the wall. Deeply unsettling.

control_room.prompt: A TV control room at night: a wall of monitors showing a red-haired woman with a gold star on her face fighting through a studio from a dozen angles, a vision mixer desk with glowing buttons, an empty producer's chair with a director's megaphone and a single gold star on the seat.

fireman.prompt: Dutch Kowalski 'The Fireman', a huge bald man with burn scars on the left side of his face, in a silver aluminised pyrotechnics suit with welding goggles on his forehead, holding a flamethrower on a burning soundstage; behind him a replica black Cadillac on fire, studio lights and cameras.

fireman_down.prompt: A defeated giant pyrotechnician in a scorched silver fire suit sitting against a burning studio set, laughing, while studio cameras with red tally lights close in on him and a big light-bulb scoreboard above reads FINISH and SPARE with glowing numbers.

phone_bank.prompt: A late-night TV telethon phone bank: rows of operators in headsets answering beige phones under a neon sign reading CALL NOW, a big tote board of glowing numbers, everyone smiling too hard. Surreal and creepy.

news_studio_fire.prompt: A TV news anchor, a woman in her 40s with big auburn 80s hair and a magenta blazer, at a news desk; the screen behind her shows a burning television studio with fire trucks; her professional smile does not reach her eyes.

credits_tv.prompt: Close-up of an old CRT television in a dark motel room showing white end credits scrolling over black; the clearly legible line on screen reads EXECUTIVE PRODUCER  T. MORENO. The TV glow is the only light; a hand holding a VCR remote in the foreground.

harcourt_office.prompt: A tense standoff in a 1960s motel office at night: Cass Moreno with a gold star over her eye, red leather jacket, aiming a pistol; across the desk Lyle Harcourt, a man in his 50s with slicked silver hair and a cream suit, hands half-raised, calm and sad. Neon light through blinds.

room_204.prompt: Motel room 204 at night: an old CRT television and VCR on a dresser playing a damaged tape of a car stunt, a stack of VHS tapes, a Polaroid and a motel key on the bedspread, rain on the window, neon sign light bleeding in.

mom_kitchen.prompt: A small 1980s kitchen in Van Nuys at night. A tired, kind woman in her late 50s (Cass's mother: greying auburn hair in a loose bun, cardigan over a floral blouse) sits alone at the kitchen table holding a wall phone's receiver to her ear, its long curly cord stretched across the room. In front of her a birthday cake with unlit candles. On the fridge a photo of two smiling children held by a gold star magnet. Fireworks bloom silently through the window. No men in the scene. Tender and lonely.

motel_dream.prompt: A cheap motel room at 4 AM: Cass Moreno, red-haired woman with a gold star greasepaint over her left eye smudged, asleep in her clothes on top of the bedspread, one hand still holding a pistol; the old CRT television at the foot of the bed shows only static that lights the whole room blue; shadows on the wall look like people standing around the bed.

villa_gate.prompt: A nightmare: a huge 1920s Spanish-style Hollywood mansion on a hill under a blood-red full moon, every window lit, a banner over the door reading WRAP PARTY; the lawn in front is a graveyard of fresh graves with gold stars on the headstones; dead hands pushing out of the soil; fog, dead palm trees, lightning.

wrap_party.prompt: A haunted ballroom party in a 1920s Hollywood mansion: dozens of pale, translucent ghostly guests in 1980s clothes - security guards, bikers, stagehands, a bellhop - dancing slowly under a crystal chandelier, each with a small gold star painted on the face, their eyes blank; a film crew of shadowy figures filming them; red candlelight, fog, champagne. Eerie and melancholy, no gore.

burning_tommy.prompt: A tragic horror boss: Tommy Moreno as a burning man standing in a mansion ballroom, his body wreathed in flame, his blue varsity jacket burning, arms open wide as if for a hug, the Cadillac wreck burning behind him, the dead crowd watching in a circle holding candles.

mirror_dead.prompt: Cass Moreno, red-haired woman with a gold star greasepaint over her left eye, looks into a gilded mansion mirror; her reflection is her own corpse, grey-skinned, smiling, surrounded by the reflections of dead people standing right behind her who are not in the room. Horror.

wake_motel.prompt: Dawn in a cheap motel room: Cass Moreno, a red-haired woman in a red leather jacket with a smudged gold star painted over her left eye, sitting upright in bed, startled and breathing hard, staring at the room; the TV shows a colour test pattern; a beige phone on the nightstand is ringing. Grey-blue morning light through the blinds.

casting_1990.prompt: A corkboard in a motel room covered in Polaroids connected with red string: an arcade called GALAXY PALACE with a girl in a harlequin jacket circled in marker and labelled THE FOOL, a Beverly Hills house, a nightclub called BLUE HOUR, a tired policewoman at a desk; gold star stickers on each; a map of Los Angeles; a bus ticket to 1990 as a joke-shaped date stamp.

lobby_phone.prompt: Cass Moreno, a red-haired woman in a red leather jacket with a gold star painted over her left eye, standing behind the wrecked front desk of a 1960s motel lobby at night, holding an old beige telephone receiver to her ear, bullet holes in the wood panelling, papers scattered, a neon VACANCY sign glowing through the window.

tommy_trapped.prompt: Inside a black 1970s Cadillac at night: a young man's hand with a blue satin varsity jacket cuff pressed flat against the driver's window from the inside, orange firelight outside the glass, smoke curling at the edges. No face visible. Tragic and tense, not graphic.

dead_line.prompt: Close-up of an old beige telephone receiver dangling on its coiled cord off the edge of a motel front desk, swinging slightly, the cord stretched, a faint tape-hiss haze in the air, neon light.

barstow_fireworks.prompt: Cass Moreno, a red-haired woman in a red leather jacket with a gold star painted over her left eye, seen from behind, standing in the doorway of a motel lobby looking out at the night sky over a small desert town, fireworks bursting silently in red, gold and blue over Barstow, the neon motel sign in the foreground.

tote_board.prompt: A giant 1980s telethon tote board of light bulbs above a burning TV soundstage, reading FINISH 2,114,902 and SPARE 11 in glowing numbers, sparks and smoke drifting in front of it.

canned_applause.prompt: A TV studio audience section of empty seats where cardboard cut-out audience members with painted smiles are propped up, a speaker box labelled APPLAUSE blaring, red ON AIR sign, smoke from the fire drifting across. Eerie satire.

cameras_shot.prompt: Cass Moreno, a red-haired woman in a red leather jacket with a gold star painted over her left eye, seen from behind in a burning TV studio, aiming a pistol at a row of big studio cameras; the nearest camera's lens is shattered and sparking; the monitors on the wall behind turn to white static one after another.

dead_applause.prompt: A haunted mansion ballroom after a fire has just gone out: thin smoke rising from a scorched circle on the parquet floor, and around it a crowd of pale translucent ghostly guests in 1980s clothes applauding politely, gold stars painted on their faces. Melancholy, no gore.

holding_tommy.prompt: Cass Moreno, a red-haired woman in a red leather jacket with a gold star painted over her left eye kneeling on a ballroom floor, holding her brother Tommy - a young man with curly brown hair in a blue varsity jacket - in her arms; soft golden flames flicker gently around them like candlelight without burning; ghostly guests watch from the shadows. Tender, dreamlike, not gory.

tv_mansion.prompt: Close-up of an old CRT television at the foot of a motel bed at night: on the screen, through static, a mansion on a hill under a red moon with a banner reading WRAP PARTY over the door; the TV glow is the only light.

extinguisher.prompt: Close-up at asphalt level on a desert road at night: a red fire extinguisher lying on its side, just dropped, its gauge needle on EMPTY, a burning car blurred in the background and film crew boots nearby.

star_on_mirror.prompt: A small bathroom mirror ringed with vanity bulbs, with a gold five-pointed star painted directly on the glass in greasepaint, fingerprints in the paint; the room behind it empty, a red leather jacket gone from the hook. Morning light.

dogs_silent.prompt: A floodlit desert salvage yard at night seen through an office window whose glass has just blown white with a flash; outside, a dozen guard dogs stand frozen and silent, all staring at the window.

pov_test_pattern.prompt: First-person view from a motel bed at dawn: a hand holding a revolver pointed at an old CRT television that shows a colour-bar test pattern; grey morning light through the blinds; rumpled bedsheets in the foreground.

phone_ringing.prompt: Close-up of a beige 1980s telephone on a motel nightstand at dawn, ringing so hard the receiver jumps in its cradle, motion blur, a pistol and a smudged tin of gold greasepaint beside it.

corkboard_note.prompt: Close-up of a police station corkboard at night covered in crime-scene Polaroids with gold star stickers, and a handwritten note pinned in the centre that reads: THE STAR KILLER IS NOT ONE PERSON. CHECK THE CREDITS.

ev_tape_roll7.prompt: A CRT TV screen showing grainy VHS footage with tracking lines: a burning Cadillac on a desert road, and a stuntwoman walking out of the fire unharmed, film crew silhouettes; a timecode in the corner.

ev_photo_harcourt.prompt: An old Polaroid on a motel desk: a younger silver-haired man in a HOTSHOT film crew jacket standing next to a man whose face has been scratched out of the photo with a key; handwriting on the white border reads Residuals - A.V.

ev_tape_vance.prompt: A CRT TV screen showing grainy VHS footage: on a rooftop at dusk, a grey-haired stunt coordinator walks a smiling young man with curly hair to the edge; far below, the ground, and no landing pad.

ev_photo_kennel.prompt: An old Polaroid pinned in a salvage-yard kennel: a big rottweiler wearing a small HOTSHOT film crew jacket, sitting proudly; written on the border: Employee of the month.

ev_tape_pilot.prompt: A CRT TV screen split into four grainy VHS security views of a motel at night, a red-haired woman in a doorway in one of them, and a title card overlay reading NEXT WEEK - THE DOGS.

ev_photo_casting.prompt: A clipped stack of Polaroids on a TV control desk: the top one shows a girl in a harlequin jacket at an arcade machine labelled THE FOOL; the edge of another shows a tired policewoman at a desk; the last one has its face cut out with a gold star sticker over the hole.

ev_tape_dream.prompt: A CRT TV screen showing grainy VHS footage of a wild 1987 film crew party in a mansion: people cheering at a television in the corner that shows a car exploding; a man in aviator sunglasses in the crowd clapping.

ev_photo_nursery.prompt: An old faded Polaroid of two children, a boy of about ten with curly brown hair and a red-haired girl of about eight, sitting on the hood of a black Cadillac wearing paper gold stars, sunny 1970s California driveway; handwriting on the border: My two stars.

t_tape.prompt: Extreme close-up of a black VHS tape with a handwritten label reading HOTSHOT in red marker being pushed into a top-loading VCR, the VCR's green LED clock blinking 12:00, a dark room lit only by the blue glow of a CRT television, dust in the light.

t_drive.prompt: Cass Moreno driving an old red Cadillac alone at night on an empty desert highway, seen through the rain-streaked windscreen, her face lit green by the dashboard and orange by passing sodium lights, eyes hard, the road stretching into darkness.

t_star.prompt: Extreme close-up of Cass Moreno's left eye framed by a shiny gold greasepaint five-pointed star painted over it, a hot pink neon reflection in her iris, one tear cutting through the gold paint, lashes and skin texture in painterly detail.

t_arsenal.prompt: Top-down view of a cheap motel bedspread with things laid out neatly in a row: a baseball bat wrapped in tape, a revolver, a switchblade, a pump shotgun, a stack of Polaroids of different men, a film call sheet with names crossed out in red, a room key on a plastic tag, striped neon light falling through window blinds.

t_corridor.prompt: A long second-floor motel walkway at night in heavy rain, a row of numbered doors, one door half open spilling warm light and a long shadow, a flickering pink neon sign reflected in the puddles, an ice machine humming, nobody in sight.

t_dogs.prompt: Behind a rusted chain-link fence topped with razor wire in a salvage yard at night, a pack of big guard dogs stand in the dust, their eyes glowing in the dark, one sodium lamp overhead, stacked wrecked cars, drifting dust.

t_studio.prompt: An empty 1980s TV game-show studio: the audience seats are filled with rows of pale shop mannequins wearing party hats, a giant prize wheel with neon bulbs, a red APPLAUSE sign lit up, spotlights cutting through haze, confetti on the floor.

t_fire.prompt: The silhouette of a huge man in a bulky fireproof suit standing still in front of a wall of roaring flame on a film soundstage, a burning car behind him, embers swirling, the lights of studio rigs above, dramatic backlight.

t_mansion.prompt: The grand staircase of a decaying gothic mansion at night, blood-red rain running down tall arched windows, a crystal chandelier swaying, thick fog on the floor, tall thin shadowy figures standing motionless at the top of the stairs, candles guttering.

t_monitors.prompt: A dark TV control room with a wall of thirty glowing CRT monitors, each showing security camera footage of the same red-haired woman in a red leather jacket from a different angle, an empty swivel chair in front of the desk, cigarette smoke in the blue light.

t_marv.prompt: Close-up of TV host Marv Kessel laughing into a microphone, shown on a curved CRT screen with rolling scan lines and colour bleeding, big white teeth, sweat, a studio light flaring behind him, unsettling.

t_phone.prompt: A motel payphone at night in the rain, the handset hanging off the hook on its metal cord and swinging, the coin slot glowing, a neon VACANCY sign buzzing above, puddles reflecting magenta and cyan.

t_walk.prompt: Cass Moreno walking straight toward the camera down a wet neon-lit street at night, a baseball bat hanging from one hand, her red leather jacket open, the gold star painted over her left eye, a car burning behind her throwing orange light and smoke, low heroic angle.

arlo_wide.prompt: Inside a cluttered salvage-yard office trailer at night: old Arlo, a skinny grey-bearded man in a stained undershirt, sunk in a busted recliner surrounded by six small TVs showing security feeds, a sleeping bulldog at his feet, beer cans, Cass Moreno standing in the doorway in her red leather jacket, dusty lamp light.

cass_listens.prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot past an old man's grey head onto Cass Moreno's face as she listens, jaw clenched, eyes wet, the gold star over her left eye, lit by the blue flicker of TV screens in a dark trailer.

fire_windshield.prompt: Point of view from inside a dark truck cab at night looking through a dusty windshield: out on the desert road a car is engulfed in a towering column of fire, the glass reflecting the flames, a thermos and a crumpled blanket on the dashboard.

dutch_3am.prompt: At 3 a.m. in the desert, a huge bald man in coveralls walks away from the camera toward a lone stunt car parked on the road, carrying a metal toolbox, his long shadow thrown by a single work light, stars overhead, a sleeping film crew's trailers in the distance.

vance_boys.prompt: A faded 1950s snapshot look: two young brothers crouched on a sunny backyard sidewalk, the younger one holding a magnifying glass over the ground with a thin wisp of smoke rising, smiling too calmly, the older boy looking away uneasy, washed-out Kodachrome colours.

machine_close.prompt: Macro close-up of a 1980s answering machine: the tiny cassette spinning behind a smoked plastic window, the red MESSAGE light blinking, the speaker grille, rain light from a window sliding across the plastic.

earl_tv.prompt: A local TV news interview shown on a CRT: an old man in a cardigan standing in a motel doorway at night, police lights behind him, a news microphone held up to him, a lower-third banner with no readable text, scan lines.

phone_cass.prompt: Cass Moreno in a dark motel lobby pressing an old beige telephone receiver to her ear, the gold star over her left eye, bloodied knuckles, neon from the window cutting across her face, the cord stretched tight, suspicious and furious.

rudy_backstage.prompt: Rudy, a frantic skinny floor manager with a headset, huge 80s glasses and a clipboard, rushing down a cramped TV studio backstage corridor full of cables, flight cases and a rack of sequined costumes, a red ON AIR light above a door.

tommy_grin.prompt: Tommy Moreno, a young stuntman with messy dark hair, grinning in the driver's seat of a black Cadillac at night in the desert, a fire-proof racing suit half zipped, helmet on his lap, lit by the film crew's big lights through the windscreen.

h_door.prompt: A motel manager's back office seen from the doorway as the door swings open: Lyle Harcourt, a heavy balding man in a sweat-stained short-sleeve shirt and loosened tie, behind a desk covered in VHS tapes, a pump shotgun lying on the blotter, a bank of small monitors showing the motel's hallways, a single green banker's lamp, cigarette smoke.

h_reveal.prompt: Close-up of Lyle Harcourt, a heavy balding sweating man, recognising someone: his eyes wide, the reflection of a gold star in his glasses, an old tarnished FIRE WATCH badge pinned to his shirt, monitor glow on his face.

h_alarm.prompt: A fat hand slamming a red alarm button under a motel front desk, the lobby behind flooding red with a rotating light, a bell ringing on the wall, keys swinging on their hooks.

h_down.prompt: Lyle Harcourt slumped on the floor against a dented filing cabinet in a wrecked motel office, exhausted and beaten but alive, holding an old faded Polaroid in his shaking hand, spilled VHS tapes around him, red alarm light washing the room.

h_polaroid.prompt: Close-up of an old faded 1987 Polaroid held in a trembling hand: a desert film crew posing in front of a black Cadillac stunt car, a young smiling stuntman in a racing suit in the middle, a heavy man at the edge holding a red fire extinguisher, one face scratched out with a pen.

d_stage.prompt: A live TV game-show stage: a huge bald man with burn scars in a silver fireproof suit stands in the centre spotlight lighting the pilot flame of his flamethrower, rows of pale mannequins in party hats in the audience, a giant prize wheel behind him, cameras on cranes pointed at him.

d_tote.prompt: A giant 1980s electronic tote board over a TV studio with two big glowing columns labelled with numbers only, digits flipping fast, a telephone-bank of empty operators' desks below, all phones ringing, lights flashing.

d_changeorder.prompt: Extreme close-up of a crumpled, scorched film-production change-order form on a burning stage floor, a signature at the bottom in elegant loopy handwriting, a thumbprint in soot, embers drifting across it. No other readable text.

d_cameras.prompt: Cass Moreno from behind in her red leather jacket shooting out a row of TV studio cameras one after another, each camera exploding in sparks and glass, the ON AIR sign flickering, smoke and fire in the background.

b_party.prompt: A burning Hollywood mansion ballroom during a macabre party: ghostly pale guests in 1980s evening wear frozen mid-applause, and walking through them a young stuntman whose racing suit and skin are charred and still smouldering, his eyes kind and sad, fire dripping from the chandeliers.

b_embrace.prompt: On the scorched floor of a burning ballroom, Cass Moreno kneels and holds her charred brother in her arms while small flames still flicker on him, she is crying, the gold star over her eye streaked, rows of pale ghostly guests watching silently.

b_credits.prompt: End credits rolling on an old CRT television in a dark empty motel room at dawn: white lines of credits scrolling on black, one line near the bottom glowing brighter than the rest, a hand reaching toward the screen, rain on the window.

sprites.style: Top-down video game sprite seen from directly overhead: strict orthographic bird's-eye view looking straight down at 90 degrees, no perspective, no horizon, no side faces visible. A single isolated object centred on a fully transparent background, no floor, no cast shadow. Detailed realistic painted style, 1980s California at night with subtle magenta and cyan neon reflections, crisp clean silhouette that reads at small size.

car_red.prompt: A red 1970s Cadillac Eldorado convertible with the roof up, seen from directly above, the front of the car pointing to the RIGHT, chrome bumpers, whitewall edges visible, windscreen reflecting neon.

car_blue.prompt: A faded blue 1980s four-door sedan seen from directly above, front pointing to the RIGHT, a little rust, a dent in the roof.

car_white.prompt: A white 1980s station wagon with wood panelling seen from directly above, front pointing to the RIGHT, roof rack.

car_black.prompt: A black 1980s Lincoln Town Car seen from directly above, front pointing to the RIGHT, tinted windows, glossy paint with neon reflections.
